tei:div.tei:p: 417) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bskang ba byin rlabs dbyig thob mos pa'i do shal bzhugs so: 418) na mo dzñā na ḍā ki ye:

ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha la 'dud: rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yisaḥ rgyal yum mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: bskang bshags zab mor brtson pa'i thabs: dgongs pa'i dbyings kyi brda las babs: dag pa dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod rdzas bsags: nam mkha' mdzod du byin gyis brlabs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid bde skyong bhandha'i nang: 'dod yon longs spyod bsam mi khyab: nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin du: mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min brdal khyab pho brang nas: skye med rig stong mkha' 'gro ma: rdo rje phag mo rgyal ba'i yum: ḍā ki yongs kyi gtso mo che: bskang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dbu skra zar bu ta la la: dar dpyangs cod paṇa lhabs se lhab: rus rgyan g.yer kha khro lo lo: zhabs gnyis gar stabs shigs se shig: dgyes pa'i bshugs glu lhangs se lhang: rmad byung dkyil 'khor bkod re legs: rnal 'byor pho mo dam dang ldan: gsang rdzas tshogs mchod yid re spro: rgyal yum mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: bskang ba'i gnas 'dir tiṣṭha lhan: phyi nang mchod pa sna 419)tshogs dang: gsang mchod rnam dag bdud rtsi sman: rgyal yum mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang: 'khor ba dbyings sgrol rakta che: rgyal yum mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang: snang srid dpal yon bha liṃ tas: rgyal yum mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang: maṃ sa dza gad thod rnga'i sgra: rkang gling sil snyan rol mor bcas: rgyal yum mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang: nyams chag sgrib pa kun dag nas: tshangs par stsol la bdag cag gi: bde stong ye shes bskyed du gsol: snang srid brda chos shar ba dang: lhan skyes ye shes rang dbang 'byor: rlung sems dbyer med dbu mar thim: kha sbyor bdun ldan ye sangs rgyas: gzhon nu bum skur 'grub par shog: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang bzhin rnam dag lhun grub pho brang nas: ye shes dbyings spyod mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum:

dkyil dang 'khor gyi rnam par shar ba kun: bskang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dbu skra zar bu ta la la: nas: gzhon nu bum skur 'grub par shog: zhes pa'i bar: hūm̐ hrīḥ gdangs snang ma 'gags 'od lnga'i pho brang nas: rdo rje rin chen padma mkha' 'gro dang: las kyi mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma: ye shes sgyu ma'i gar sgyur bde skyed yum: gnas 420)skyes zhing skyes sngags skyes mdza' na mo: bcu drug dga' ster mchog gi pho nya bcas: mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro ma tshogs rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bskang ba'i gnas= nas: 'grub par shog: zhes pa'i bar: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma brtsigs rang byung dur khrod chen po nas: ma nges gnas yul skyong zhing gsang sngags bdag: 'bum phrag drug cu'i bka' yi srung ma che: ma mo e ka dzā ṭi 'khor dang bcas: dpal ldan lha mo re ti dmag zor ma: tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs: gsang sngags bka' yi srung ma thams cad la: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs dang: māṃ sa dza gad rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra: rol mo dbyangs snyan thugs mthun mchod pa'i tshogs: dbyings kyi rje mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: ma mo 'khor dang bcas pa'-i thugs dam bskang: bka' srung gter bdag rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskangs la nyams chag dag par mdzod: tshangs par stsol la bdag cag gi: bde stong ye shes bskyed du gsol: snang srid brda chos shar ba dang: lhan skyes ye shes rang dbang 'byor: rlung sems dbyer med dbu mar thim: kha sbyor bdun ldan ye sangs rgyas: gzhon nu bum sku 'grub par shog: bshags pa ni: 421)hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs ma lus dgongs: bdag cag gsang sngags dkyil 'khor la zhugs nas: ma rig dbang gis bskyed bzlas g.yel ba dang: sgo gsum bag med las bsags thams cad kun: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: le lo snyoms las gnyid kyi dbang gyur pas: log rtog nyon mongs rang gar spyad pa yis:

so byang sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa rnams: 'dod yon tshogs= 'dzin med rang grol chen po'i don ma rtogs: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang 'gal ba gang: 'dod yon tshogs= rig pa ka dag rtsa bral gnyug ma cheḥ mtha' brgyad spros bral zang thal phyogs lhung bral: skye 'gag gnas bral ye shes chen po la: phyogs ris gud du bcad nas 'khrul par 'khyams: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i= 'dod yon= 'khrul bral ye shes chen po'i rang mdangs la: rtog tshogs rang grol 'khor 'das rgyan du shar: spang blang gnyis med mnyam nyid chos dbyings la: ma rig dbang gis bzang ngan re dogs zhugs: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i= 'dod yon= snang srid ye dag chos sku'i rol pa la: ma 'gags rol rtsal lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje kun khyab rang grol sprul pa'i sku: 422)sku gsum dbyer med rang rig gzhi la rdzogs: stong dbyings rig stong mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la: tha dad med pa 'od gsal chen po'i klong: du ma ro gcig mnyam nyid lta ba'i ngang: bskang dang bshags bya dmigs med yul las 'das: rang grol bde ba chen po'i klong du grol: bshags bya bshags byed bral ba'i klong du āḥ oṃ sa ma ya: āḥs ma ya: hūm̐ sa ma ya: oṃ dzñā na ḍā ki ni badzra satwa sa ma yaḥ sogs: āḥ lan gsum brjod: nyams chag nyes ltung ma lus dag: dngos grub thob nas don gnyis 'grub: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral 'khod nas kyang: 'og min zhing la bgrod par nges: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: skal med rnams la 'di ma 'phrad: rtog ge mkhan la gu hya rgyaḥ dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig: dam nyams lag tu ma shor bar: thub par srungs shig sa ma ya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: gnyan rgya: (Dakini secret letter here) ḍākki'i rgya: : ces ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bskang ba mos pa'i do shal 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po tri ya kirti pradzñā pra wa sogs dang padma kun bzang snang mdzad bcas kyis rin chen gnyis pa'i maṇḍal bcas bskul ngor chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong nas mdo med sprang mo dud 'gro lta bu'i 'du shes gsum pa su kha badzra gyis brdzun snang ri mor bris pa'o/
